items.name: Big Cubes for Dunwoody 2020

venue.name: Dunwoody Community Church
venue.details: Theater. Through the double doors to the right of where you enter.

items.information: To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue.

items.name: Downtown Vancouver Winter 2020
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the "[Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DowntownVancouverWinter2020#12449-competitor-responsibilities)" tab. For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out our [website!](https://www.pnwcubing.com)

items.name: Fontwell Open 2020
items.information: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **PLEASE NOTE:** For this competition, there will be a competitor limit of 24 for Multi-Blind on a first come first serve basis. If you register for Multi-Blind and are not within the first 24 people registered, your registration for the event will be removed. However we will be keeping a waiting list for this specific event in the case of dropouts either before the competition or on the day. Please only consider registering for this event if you are certain you would like to compete in it.

items.name: Izhevsk Winter Cube 2020

venue.name: Linguistic Lyceum №22 named after A.S. Pushkin

items.information: Больше информации в [группе ВК](https://vk.com/izh_winter_cube2020) **ВАЖНО**: строго рекомендуется взять с тобой только **одного зрителя**. Вход зрителей в помещение чемпионата по предварительной записи. Для записи необходимо заполнить [форму](https://forms.gle/5rYsBwXkLF6Uyr1F7) --- More information in the [our website] (https://vk.com/izh_winter_cube2020) **IMPORTANT**: it is strongly recommended to take only **one spectator** with each participant. All spectators must be registered with special form. To write, you must fill out the [form](https://forms.gle/5rYsBwXkLF6Uyr1F7)

items.name: PDX Cubing for Causes 2020

venue.name: [Daimler Trucks North America Convention Center](https://www.daimler.com/career/about-us/locations/location-detail-page-5111.html)
venue.details: Rooms A-C, entrance on the right of the Daimler Lobby. Daimler HQ building is a large 10 floor building.

items.information: Proceeds from this competition will benefit the charities Oregon with Love and SchoolHouse Supplies. Daimler Trucks North America will make a 100% match of the donation made for this competition. This event is supported by PING (Parent In Networking Group) and STEM Employee Interest Groups. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PDXCubingforCauses2020#13083-competitor-responsibilities) tab. **Join our facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!** [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/8uf2SCt.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085/)

items.name: Princeton Winter 2020

venue.name: [Princeton University](http://www.princeton.edu/)
venue.address: Frist Campus Center, Frist Ln, Princeton, NJ 08544

items.information: If you would like to be on the competitor list, please carefully note exactly when registration opens, and sign up as soon as possible. This competition has filled up very quickly in the past, so do not miss out. Please see tabs for more information. Complimentary pizza will be offered during the competition. NEW POLICY: Princeton University now requires chaperones for all minors participating in on-campus events. Therefore, any child under 18 that plans to compete must be accompanied by a parent or other adult, who will be required to sign in. (Please reach out to the organizer with any issues/questions.)
